utility.notes: Woodside is a well-documented San Mateo County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy)
value.notes: WestLight Energy's own site confirms it is San Mateo County's CCA, formed in 2015 after every city council in the county voted to establish it, serving the entire county (all cities/towns, including Woodside) since 2017. PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Schedule inspections by calling the Building Department at 650-851-6790 or emailing projectmanagers@woodsideca.gov, at least 72 hours in advance
Provide the property address, permit number, and inspection type when scheduling
All reviewing departments listed on the permit card (e.g. Building, Planning, Geology, Engineering, Fire District) must finalize before a Building Department Final can be scheduled
inspection_steps.notes: This is the Town's general post-permit-issuance inspection process (the same document covers all building permit types, including solar); the Town's page does not describe a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited review for roof-mounted Solar PV (10kW and under) and solar hot water heating
other_conditions: Systems exceeding 10kW require different (non-expedited) submittal procedures
Class 'A' roofs are required in Woodside, which is in the Wild Land-Urban Interface
Fees must be received by the Town before review begins; credit cards are not accepted

permit_fees.notes: Fees are payable by check (two separate checks: one to the Town of Woodside, one to Woodside Fire Protection District) or cash, but no specific dollar amount is stated.
